text:
kai: FYI nightly CI is red for quantized-inference tests — OOM on the 8xA100 job.
kai: job: https://ci.redwood.local/masters/12345 and commit 7f3d2a1
kai: snippet from main worker log: ```RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory when allocating 23.4 GiB``` 
devon: can you paste the full job id and the node type? also which CUDA/runtime? 
kai: full job id master-12345-build-98, node a100-8x-rt, CUDA 12.2, driver 535.86
ci-bot: build 12345 failed: tests/quantized_inference::end_to_end (OOM) — rerun URL: https://ci.redwood.local/retry/12345
maria: @kai can you try a quick rerun with smaller micro-batch (1 -> 0.5) or disable interleaved batching? if it passes we know it's mem pressure.
allen: note: we pushed a host kernel/driver tweak to the infra pool yesterday evening. might be related to kernel scheduling. saw a few nvml timeouts in staging earlier.
eva: please attach dmesg and nvidia-smi -q from the failed node if available — nvml XID would be useful.
kai: attaching short logs: ```NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, pid=4321, GPU has fallen off the bus```
devon: Xid 31 usually points to a kernel/driver issue or hardware reset. but the allocate size is huge too — could be fragmentation + driver. try rerun with CUDNN_WORKSPACE_LIMIT or reduce cached kv cache.
maria: I'll start a bisect run on commit range 7e... -> 7f3d2a1 to see if the infra bump correlates. assigning to me+allen. ETA few hours.
kai: ok kicked off a rerun with --micro-batch-size=1 and disabled continuous-batch. queued as rerun-12345-2
ci-bot: rerun-12345-2 started on a100-1x node.
kai: rerun passed on single GPU node (a100-1x) but multi-gpu still failing when I spin a manual 8x reproducible test.
allen: can you try forcing older driver (534.x) on a test node? if it's a driver regression we'll see.
eva: also check if recent CUDA runtime upgrade to 12.2 changed allocator behavior for quantized kernels.
devon: if we can repro locally, we can instrument with `export TF_GPU_ALLOCATOR=cuda_malloc_async` or similar depending on runtime and capture memory peaks.
maria: plan: 1) bisect commit range 2) repro on isolated 8xA100 with older driver/12.2 combos 3) if repro, open infra bug for driver rollback or kernel tweak. tagging triage:gpu-ci
kai: thanks. I'll leave the failed job logs in the rerun thread and ping when I have dmesg + sbin log. @maria @allen please coordinate infra access.
maria: got it — I'll claim the bisect job and post interim updates in this thread :thumbsup:
ci-bot: label set: triage:gpu-ci, priority:high
kai: small note — test that fails is the quantized end-to-end with prefix caching enabled. disabling prefix cache makes it less likely to OOM.
devon: good datapoint. might be a KV caching leak in the quantized code path. adding a quick code review ping to @eva for the KV cache PR that landed 7f3d2a1.
eva: ack, looking now. if I can reproduce I can add a guard fence to free caches earlier.
maria: rough ETA: bisect results in ~3 runs (~2-3h). if it narrows to infra, we escalate to infra team. if it's code, we'll open a regression PR.
kai: cheers — will update here when rerun finishes or dmesg is uploaded.
